description: One .crewbench/tasks/<task-id>/state.json. Written and read by bin/crewbench_state.py; see lib/dispatch.md's state.json section for the field-by-field protocol (when the Team Lead updates each one).

schema_version.description: Contract version of this state.json. Missing means version 0 (legacy, written before this field existed) -- readers must handle that. Current version: 1.

id.description: YYYYMMDD-HHMM-<up to 5 word kebab slug>-<4 hex> (the hex suffix guards against same-minute id collisions; older ids without it are still valid)

lineup.description: The resolved, user-agreed lineup for this task (see lib/dispatch.md §1).

worktree.description: Absolute path, or null in in-place mode.

jira_key.description: Set when new-task's first argument matched a Jira key (e.g. PROJ-123, see lib/dispatch.md §0's 'Task folder and state'); null otherwise. crewbench never writes back to Jira on its own.

host_override.description: Set only when crewbench_env.py whoami couldn't determine the host CLI and the user was asked once (see lib/dispatch.md 'Host detection and plugin root'); null otherwise.

doctor.description: Cached crewbench_dispatch.py doctor results for this task's session, keyed by CLI name, so a non-host CLI in the lineup isn't re-checked every round (see lib/dispatch.md's Sandboxes and doctor section).

gate.description: bin/crewbench_gate.py's result for this round, when the gate ran (see lib/dispatch.md §6's 'Deterministic gate'). null when nothing was configured or the round had no gate step.

usage.description: Keyed by role name. Each value: { runs, duration_s, tokens, cost_usd, cli, model } — tokens/cost_usd stay null until a run actually reports them. See lib/dispatch.md §4's 'Usage and timing' section for the per-run aggregation rule and §7's 'Usage summary' for how it's reported.
